$comment: Register of every event an agent subscribes to that NO agent emits. Required by AEIT_11 R7. Enforced by estate_event_gate.py.

classifications.external_entry_point: A system outside the agent estate produces it. Reaches the runtime through webhook-server.ts, the only publish() call site. Correct as-is; needs no build.
classifications.manual_entry_point: A human produces it by running the agent. Correct as-is; needs no build. Must be LABELLED or a reader mistakes it for a break.
classifications.producer_unassigned: DEFECT. An agent waits on something nobody has been given the job of producing. Remedy is an OWNERSHIP DECISION, not a build.

known_reentrant_edges.$comment: Agents that emit an event they also subscribe to. The bus is a bare node EventEmitter with NO cycle detection, depth limit or dedupe, so each of these RE-ENTERS the moment executor.ts starts publishing - and a PURE loop (sole emitter == sole subscriber == same agent) does not terminate. Recorded, not fixed: all are Finance (09) and Offer (02) and belong to those departments. estate_event_gate.py check 6 fails on any edge not listed here.
